english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for using one person or thing in place of another.
Use this when one person or thing takes the place of another or is used instead of it.
Use this when compensating means doing something in place of the original action or person.

examples.english: We can substitute soy milk for cow's milk.
examples.traditional: 我哋可以用豆漿代替牛奶。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jung6 dau6 zoeng1 doi6 tai3 ngau4 naai5

examples.english: Nowadays, many restaurants use electronic menus to replace paper menus.
examples.traditional: 而家好多餐廳用電子餐牌代替紙餐牌。
examples.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 caan1 teng1 jung6 din6 zi2 caan1 paai4 doi6 tai3 zi2 caan1 paai4

examples.english: They took today off, so I’ll compensate by attending the meeting in their place.
examples.traditional: 佢今日請假，我代替佢開會。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 ceng2 gaa3 ngo5 doi6 tai3 keoi5 hoi1 wui2
